{{Quote|We all know in what high regard I hold these filthy slavers. The sooner they are captured, the sooner they will be on their way to Dles. Of all the individuals and groups in this reports ''[sic]'', it is this group I would most like to see brought to justice.|General Airen Cracken on the Mytaranor Slaving Council|<ref name="AIR" />}}
'''C'ar L'andara''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] dancer for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alexander Julstan IV|Julstan IV]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] before she escaped his [[Unidentified Imperial palace|palace]] located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. The [[Locan]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Talas Piran]] captured her shortly after, but instead of returning her, she became a leader of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]-based [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]]. By 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]], information on L'andara and the council was included on a [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] produced by the [[Task Force on Alliance Security|Task Force for Alliance Security]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am a Wookiee. I don't have to tell you my opinion of slavers. These beings, should they fall into my grasp, would never slave again, regardless of the consequences I myself would face.|Tirranna on the Mytaranor Slaving Council|<ref name="AIR" />}}
[[File:TalasPiran-AIR.png|thumb|right|300px|C'ar L'andara was captured by the enslaver Talas Piran (pictured).]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] C'ar L'andara served [[Alexander Julstan IV]], a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as a dancing girl at his [[Unidentified Imperial palace|Imperial palace]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. At a recent [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="AIR" /> to approximately [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' dates itself to approximately two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which is dated to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the sourcebook is set around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> she escaped the palace, but only [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later the dancer was captured by the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Talas Piran]]. Rather than return her to the Moff's palace, the [[Locan]] man decided that L'andara could prove useful.<ref name="AIR" />

L'andara soon became a leader of the [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]], a large enslavement group that operated in of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] out of the way of the Empire. L'andara helped her group's business transactions with the several enslaving groups based on<ref name="AIR" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="AIR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of her [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" /> Though she was new to the business, the Twi'lek learned quickly.<ref name="AIR" /> 

By 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Task Force on Alliance Security|Task Force for Alliance Security]], part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], created a [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on possible threats to them, with information on the Mytaranor Slaving Council and L'andara. In a personal addendum, General Airen Cracken noted that it was the members of the slaving group he would most like to see brought to justice. The formerly enslaved [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Tirranna]] noted, in another addendum, that if council members fell into her grasp, she would ensure they never enslaved again, even at the repercussions she might face.<ref name="AIR" /> 

==Personality and traits==
When dealing with potentially stubborn male enslavers of her species, L'andara would use her seductive manner to sway them.<ref name="AIR" />

==Skills and abilities==
L'andara, a skilled dancer, was proficient in the usage of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In combat, the woman would brawl and dodge. She was educated on survival, utilizing sneaking and hiding to her advantage. L'andara was also knowledgeable on value of enslaved persons and could skillfully bargain. Technical and mechanical abilities possessed by her included security and operation of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, respectively. As L'andara was a Twi'lek<ref name="AIR" /> with [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> head tentacles, she could use them for secret communication with other Twi'leks.<ref name="AIR" />

==Equipment==
L'andara armed herself with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Other possessions of hers included 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and manacles. At one point, she wore a light-colored [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with dark sleeves and a decorated headdress.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C'ar L'andara was introduced in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]]. In the [[1995]] book, L'andara was illustrated by artist [[Christina Wald]].<ref name="AIR" />
